SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Michael Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0137 | michael.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Claims reporting specialist with nine years at a property and casualty carrier, moved into a reporting role in 2026 after seven years in claims intake and processing. Supports the auto and property claims unit, writing SQL against the claims reporting views and maintaining a Tableau dashboard of cycle times that the unit manager reviews weekly. Known for clean files and careful checks on whether a number makes sense.

EXPERIENCE
Claims Reporting Specialist | Oakmont Casualty Insurance, Columbus, OH | Feb 2026 to Present
• Moved into a full time reporting role for the 22 person auto and property unit after a year as its part time reporting contact.
• Write SQL against the ClaimCenter reporting views (joins across claims, exposures and payments, CASE for claim type, date differences for cycle time) and share the queries in a folder the team lead can rerun.
• Built a Tableau dashboard of days from first notice to first payment by claim type, processor and week, published to the company Tableau server; the unit manager uses it in weekly workload meetings to rebalance new assignments.
• Analyzed a year of rental car bills against repair cycle times and showed that rentals ran an average of 3.4 days past the repair completion date. Daily rental check-ins on the final repair days were adopted by the unit, and average rental cost per claim fell by about $160.
• Found that reopened claims were being counted as new in the old weekly report, which had inflated the unit's volume by about 6 percent, and documented the corrected logic.

Senior Claims Processor | Oakmont Casualty Insurance, Columbus, OH | Apr 2019 to Jan 2026
• Processed 20 to 30 auto and property claims a day in Guidewire ClaimCenter, checking coverage, entering estimates and issuing payments within authority limits.
• Rebuilt a personal claims tracker into one the whole unit used, and became the unit's reporting contact in 2025.
• Requested and reviewed supporting documents such as police reports, repair invoices and photos, and verified bills against estimates and policy limits before payment.
• Flagged claims where another party may be at fault and forwarded each to the subrogation unit.
• Mentored new processors during the first month on payment authority rules and common entry mistakes.
• Kept a payment accuracy rate above 99 percent on quarterly quality audits.

Claims Intake Representative | Oakmont Casualty Insurance, Columbus, OH | Aug 2017 to Mar 2019
• Took first notice of loss calls from policyholders and agents, 50 to 70 a day, and set up new claims in the system.
• Verified policy coverage and deductibles before assigning each claim.
• Collected photos, police reports and contact details and routed claims to the correct adjuster queue.
• Set up rental and towing referrals for policyholders at first contact.
• Answered status calls and agent emails within one business day.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2017

SKILLS
SQL: joins, CASE, date functions, GROUP BY on SQL Server reporting views (about eighteen months at work)
BI and spreadsheets: Tableau (one published dashboard, calculated fields, filters), Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS)
Systems: Guidewire ClaimCenter, document imaging system, Microsoft Office
Claims: coverage verification, payment processing, first notice of loss, claim documentation
Communication: policyholder calls, written claim notes, short summaries for the unit manager

ADDITIONAL
• Introductory SQL workshop through a library continuing education program, 2025
• Completed the company's internal Tableau basics training, 2025
• Volunteer at a neighborhood food pantry, checking in visitors and updating the sign-in spreadsheet

ASSISTANT:
{
  "score": 45,
  "decision": "REJECT",
  "reason": "While Michael holds a relevant BS in Statistics and lives in Columbus, he only has about 18 months of dedicated analytics experience—short of the three-year requirement—and lacks retail or Power BI background."
}
